fields.title: 📖 The danger of hasty takfīr
fields.body:
🖋️ **The Prophet ﷺ** said:

> ***“If a man says to his brother: ‘O kāfir,’ then it returns upon one of the two.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** Takfīr is not a game with words. Whoever judges Muslims without right brings himself into great danger.

immutable.source: 📝 al-Bukhārī, Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī, Kitāb al-Adab, Bāb: Man kaffara akhāhu bi-ghayr taʾwīl fa-huwa kamā qāl, Hadith Nr. 6103.
